prompt: Wide shot across a vast dark quarry pit. Far across the quarry, embedded in the towering layered rock-strata wall, is an enormous flat fossil slab: the complete skeleton of a colossal horned beast pressed sideways into the warm grey-brown slate, ribs spine skull and horns etched as a crisp dark outline flush with the rock face, a flat carved imprint, NOT three-dimensional. Stepped quarry ledges and rubble lead down to it; tiny scale cues make the fossil read as ENORMOUS. A single faint blue-white mineral seam glows thinly across the slab. Dusty earthen quarry, warm sandstone ochre and brown stone, sunlit dust, colorless desaturated earth palette.
